module_a_fitted_config.caveat: threshold_reject = max(p99.5 of val Safe scores, hold + 0.1) and the 99.5th percentile landed at 100.0, so REJECT only fires at a saturated risk score. HOLD is the de-facto top decision. Worth knowing before a judge notices it.
